title: Rerun line
description: One /po-rerun-from: rebuild a product's output from the step where an error began. JSON Lines, UTF-8, append-only, stored at <product>/.po/reruns.jsonl. The latest line for an id is its current state; po appends a full new line at each status change. Status runs planned, approved, done, then committed, or ends at declined or abandoned.

status.description: planned: plan shown to the user. approved: the user said yes to the plan. declined: the user said no. done: rebuilt, reviewed, and every reopened gate approved again. committed: the user OK'd a commit in the products repo. abandoned: stopped part way; reason in note, files left for the user.

from.description: The step to rebuild from: normally the attribution's origin.

text.description: What is now true, in the user's words where possible.

register_ref.description: The register decision or answer that records the correction. Written before the rerun so the producer gets it as an input.

supersedes.description: Register entries the correction replaces; items that relied on them are invalidated too.

invalidated.description: Items to rebuild: the origin item and everything downstream of it, from scripts/traces.py downstream.

kept.description: Downstream items the user chose to keep as they are.

reopened_stages.description: Stages whose gate must be approved again because they hold invalidated items.

run.description: The run ID the rebuild writes under.

user_ok.description: When the user approved the plan.

commit.description: Products repo commit, only after the user's OK.
